ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels and 25% low-intensity black pixels across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white pixel regions occupy the distal and mid-lobe areas. Low-intensity black pixels are concentrated at the central peduncle insertion and radiate outward with mottled, high-frequency transitions into the white fields. A continuous dark margin follows the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 45 degrees and a significant depth into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge topography. Multiple high-amplitude peaks (10+ pixels) and valleys are concentrated on the distal halves of both lobes, transitioning to smaller, more frequent serrations near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a convex geometric sweep, tapering toward pointed and upward-curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of circular pixel groups are localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Smaller, individual circular dark spots are scattered within the high-intensity white regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible on the mid-section of the left lobe, cutting across the white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive physical trauma and irregular morphology at both lateral lobe tips due to dense colonization of barnacles or corresponding scar tissue.
